subject: Object Oriented Programming
chapters: Chapter 2: C++ Language Basics and Functions
Chapter 7: Templates, Exception Handling, and File I/O Streams

questions.text: Compare Procedure-Oriented Programming (POP) vs Object-Oriented Programming (OOP). Explain core OOP principles: Encapsulation, Data Abstraction, Inheritance, and Polymorphism with examples.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: C++ Language Basics and Functions
questions.text: Explain Inline Functions in C++. When does the compiler ignore the inline request? Explain Function Overloading and Default Arguments with code examples.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: C++ Language Basics and Functions
questions.text: Explain Pass by Value, Pass by Pointer, and Pass by Reference (Reference Variables). Explain Return by Reference with a code example.
Define Class and Object. Explain Constructors: Default Constructor, Parameterized Constructor, Copy Constructor, and Dynamic Constructor. Explain Destructors and their execution order.
Explain Friend Function and Friend Class. Why does a friend function violate data hiding? Demonstrate friend function bridging two different classes with a complete C++ program.
Explain Static Data Members and Static Member Functions in C++ with memory allocation concept and code example.
What is Operator Overloading? What are the rules for operator overloading? Which operators cannot be overloaded in C++?
Write a C++ program to overload binary `+` operator to add two `Complex` numbers (real and imag) and two `Time` objects (hr, min, sec).
Write a C++ program to overload unary `++` and `--` operators in both Prefix and Postfix forms using member functions.
Explain Data Type Conversions in C++: (a) Basic to Class type (using constructor), (b) Class to Basic type (using casting operator function), and (c) One Class type to Another Class type.
Explain types of Inheritance: Single, Multiple, Multilevel, Hierarchical, and Hybrid Inheritance with syntax and block diagrams.
Explain Ambiguity in Multiple Inheritance and Multipath (Diamond) Inheritance problem. How does Virtual Base Class solve the diamond problem? Explain with C++ program.
Explain Constructor and Destructor invocation order in Derived and Base classes during single and multiple inheritance.
Differentiate between Compile-Time (Early/Static Binding) Polymorphism vs Run-Time (Late/Dynamic Binding) Polymorphism in C++.
Explain Virtual Functions and Pure Virtual Functions. Explain Abstract Base Class. Demonstrate dynamic binding using base class pointer pointing to derived class objects.
Explain Virtual Destructor and why a base class destructor should always be declared virtual when deleting derived objects via base pointers.

questions.chapter: Chapter 7: Templates, Exception Handling, and File I/O Streams
questions.text: Explain Function Templates and Class Templates. Write a generic C++ class template for a `Stack` data structure supporting `int`, `float`, and `char` data types.

questions.chapter: Chapter 7: Templates, Exception Handling, and File I/O Streams
questions.text: Explain Exception Handling in C++ using `try`, `catch`, and `throw` blocks. Explain multiple catch blocks, catch-all handler (`catch(...)`), and rethrowing exceptions.

questions.chapter: Chapter 7: Templates, Exception Handling, and File I/O Streams
questions.text: Explain C++ File I/O Stream hierarchy (`ifstream`, `ofstream`, `fstream`). Write a C++ program to write student objects (name, roll, marks) into a binary file `student.dat` and read/search records using `read()` and `write()` functions.
